<arc/>Arc Weapon Kills progress a counter that spawns an <arc/>Ionic Trace at the killed target's location upon reaching 100%.

Activation progress granted by <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors: 34%
• Elites, Players: 67%
• Minibosses and Bosses: 100%

Collecting <arc/>Ionic Traces grants a Stack of <arc/>Bolt Charge.

Scoring multiple <arc/>Arc Weapon Kills spawns an <arc/>Ionic Trace at the killed target's location.

Activation progress granted by <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors: 34%
• Elites, Players: 67%
• Minibosses and Bosses: 100%
